Calls himself a vegetarian, go figure. |id = THORN_1, MASTER_THORN_1 }} {{For|the Enchantment {{Ench|Thorns}}|Thorns}} '''Thorn '''is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]]. He is a ghast which spawns animals and can only be damaged by his Spirit Bow. Thorn's remains re-appear on [[The Catacombs - Floor V|Floor V]], from which [[Livid]] drains energy in order to clone himself. == Collection == Killing Thorn increases the Thorn collection. {{CollectionTable|Thorn}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Overview === Unlike most of the other bosses in The Catacombs, Thorn only has one apparent phase, same as Livid, however technically has different phases, but the differences are minuscule. Thorn will speed up the more he has been damaged and when he is about to die in one more hit, Thorn will start turning around, making it harder to hit him. Additionally, with each wave that comes, the Spirit Animals gain more HP, overall making it a longer fight. After {{Green|15s}} of dialogue, Thorn will summon Spirit Animals which can deal damage to the player along with a new {{mcat|miniboss}} called the Spirit Bear. A counter (indicated by a ring of [[Sea Lantern]]s and [[Block of Coal|Coal Blocks]] near the audience) shows how many Spirit Animals have been killed. When the ring fully lights up with Sea Lanterns, the Spirit Bear will spawn. There is a crowd of enemies cheering for Thorn in the arena. While they can't attack the player, they can give helpful hints for Thorn's attacks. Although, if the player enters the crowds viewing area, swarms of spirit bats will attack the player and deal large quantities of damage. Occasionally, one of the circles in the arena will change color, either green or orange. If it turns green, it will ready up a Healing Circle much like the Healer's one, but if it turns orange, it will start a fire on that circle. Thorn's spirit animals will take 5% of their HP every second they are in the fire. === Spirit Bear === The Spirit Bear is a {{mcat|mb}} summoned during the fight. It will be summoned once 25 Spirit Animals (or 30 in Master Mode) have been killed. It has {{hp|5M}} (or {{hp|180M}} in Master Mode) and can attack players with a Golden Sword or a Spirit Bow. The spirit bear will heal overtime, but very slowly. When the Spirit Bear is killed, it drops a Spirit Bow. The player who picks it up only gets one chance to shoot Thorn. Each successful hit stuns Thorn for {{Green|5s}}, followed by a {{Green|1s}} cooldown before Thorn can be damaged again. Every hit from the Spirit Bow removes {{hp|1}} from Thorn’s health. Once Thorn’s health reaches zero, they die. === Summoned Mobs === Throughout the fight, various Spirit Mobs will spawn in. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bull}} - These rush towards the player to attack them. They also have a charge attack, dealing {{Red|30%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in regular mode ({{Stat|Damage|846.6|icononly=yes}}) and {{Red|75%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|53,550|icononly=yes}}). * {{MobSprite|Spirit Wolf}} - These will swarm players and attack them in large quantities. They deal {{Red|3.5x}} damage to players using the [[Tank]] [[Class]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bat}} - These will swarm players who are in the air. They do not respect player invincibility frames. This means if a player jumps in the air and is swarmed by bats, they will be mowed to death in seconds. Can be deterred by decoys as they have no vanilla attacking ability and cannot destroy it. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Rabbit}} - These will attack the player, launching them in the air, and then run away. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Chicken}} - These slowly descends to the ground, strike nearby players with lightning. If it touches the ground, it will turn into a Chicken Mine. Players who walk over it take damage and are knocked into the air. The lightning attacks deal {{Red|1.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|1,392|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode, and {{Red|0.35x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|9,408|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Sheep}} - These run toward the player and explodes like a creeper. This deals up to {{Red|0.2x}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}}, or {{Stat|Damage|3,808|icononly=yes}} in regular mode and {{Stat|Damage|133,280|icononly=yes}} in [[Master Mode]], with the amount depending on close the player was to the explosion.{{Confirm}} {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bear}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bull}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Wolf}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bat}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Rabbit}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Chicken}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Sheep}} }} == Drops == Killing Thorn will complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Master Mode Loot}} == Dialogue == === Thorn === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro |{{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Welcome Adventurers! No man at all.''" references ''Breaking Bad'', in which Gustavo Fring asks Hector Salamanca "''What kind of man talks to the DEA? No man, no man at all.''" **"''Avenge Bonzo! #RememberBonzo''" and "''Remember Bonzo! #NeverForget''" references {{MobSprite|Bonzo}}, the boss of [[The Catacombs - Floor I]], hinting that the two are connected. Notably, Bonzo is a circus clown and Thorn hosts a performance. **"''My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined.''" references the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/my-disappointment-is-immeasurable-and-my-day-is-ruined quote of the same name], in which host of TheReportOfTheWeek, Reviewbrah, says the exact quote after tasting Popeyes' cheddar biscuit butterfly shrimp. **''"Fs in the chat!''" is a reference to the meme [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/press-f-to-pay-respects originating from 2014's Call of Duty Advanced Wafare], where there is an event in the campaign where you have to "Press F to pay respects", which eventually has been used by gamers in the event of a huge loss. ==Tips== *There is currently a bug that allows players can stun '''Thorn''' in place using a {{Item|Tribal Spear}} or {{Item|Bonemerang}}. This is commonly used by players to make the bossfight easier. **Attempting to stun '''Thorn''' but failing the stun whilst Thorn is still alive will make '''Thorn''' will become extremely fast. This is because when '''Thorn''' gets hit with the [[Tribal Spear]] or [[Bonemerang]] it treats it like he got hit with the [[Spirit Bow (Thorn)|Spirit Bow]] which increases his speed. **The {{Item|Terminator}}'s "{{an|Salvation}}" ability can also cause him to reach this state but it is much more difficult, since the ability can only be cast after landing {{green|3}} hits with the bow. == Gallery == Thorn Orb.png|'''Thorn'''{{'}}s remains during the [[Livid]] boss fight == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/July 30|[[File:Thorn.png|26px]] Added '''Thorn'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]
